name: geo-perf-compare
description: Side-by-side performance comparison of a React + Vite and a Rust (Leptos/WASM) map frontend rendering GeoJSON points.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix dashboard install && npm --prefix apps/react-vite install && node scripts/generate-geojson.mjs
scripts.start: concurrently -n dash,react,rust -c cyan,blue,yellow "npm --prefix dashboard run dev" "npm --prefix apps/react-vite run prod" "npm run rust:prod"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n dash,react,rust -c cyan,blue,yellow "npm --prefix dashboard run dev" "npm --prefix apps/react-vite run dev" "npm run rust:dev"
scripts.deploy:vercel: npm run build:site && npx vercel@latest deploy dist --prod
